tools.name: search_finportal
tools.description: Search FinPortal's already-stored public records when an agent needs evidence for a topic, event, or company. Select all, domestic, global, or editorial scope; results include source, date, URL, and only permitted excerpts—not third-party full text or live market data.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Use for a concise feed of the most recent stored Macedonian business and international news. Results are saved snapshots, not a live feed, and retain attribution and original links.

tools.name: get_domestic_news
tools.description: Use when the question concerns Macedonian public-company announcements or official statistics/audit releases. Filter by MSE, SEI-Net, DZS, or DZR; only public metadata already shown on FinPortal is returned.

tools.name: get_global_news
tools.description: Use for stored international financial news. Returns FinPortal's translated title and short translated summary with publisher, date, and original URL; never returns the original publisher's full text.

tools.name: get_editorial_articles
tools.description: List original FinPortal editorial articles that are currently published. Use get_editorial_article with an ID or slug only when the full FinPortal-owned article is needed.

tools.name: get_editorial_article
tools.description: Retrieve the full body of one published, FinPortal-authored editorial article by ID or slug. This does not expose third-party articles or unpublished drafts.

tools.name: get_blog_story_summary
tools.description: Retrieve the public summary for a published FinPortal story by slug. Returns a short displayed excerpt and source link only; do not use it to retrieve third-party full text.

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Use for public news and editorial mentions of a company. Macedonian Stock Exchange issuers resolve by exact ticker, Cyrillic name, Latin transliteration, and curated aliases; pass company or ticker, and cite each returned source/date/URL.

tools.name: get_company_timeline
tools.description: Build a newest-first timeline of stored public mentions for a company or ticker. Use get_company_intelligence when a bounded date range and records grouped by source category are needed; this tool does not forecast price or performance.

tools.name: resolve_company
tools.description: Resolve a Macedonian Stock Exchange issuer from an exact ticker, Macedonian Cyrillic name, Latin transliteration, or curated alias. Returns candidates when an alias is ambiguous; it never guesses and does not return prices.

tools.name: get_company_intelligence
tools.description: Create a bounded, source-attributed evidence package for a Macedonian Stock Exchange issuer. Resolves Cyrillic/Latin names and ticker, filters stored filings, news, FinPortal editorial, public stories, and active public document metadata by date range, and groups results by source. Use for company r

tools.name: get_mse_announcements
tools.description: List stored Macedonian Stock Exchange announcement metadata with publication date and original link. Only the short description already displayed by FinPortal is returned, never the full third-party announcement.

tools.name: get_seinet_filings
tools.description: List stored SEI-Net public filing metadata with date and original link. Use this for issuer disclosure discovery; do not treat the excerpt as a complete filing.

tools.name: get_dzs_releases
tools.description: List stored State Statistical Office of Macedonia release metadata with date and original link. This tool does not expose full reports or calculate new statistics.

tools.name: get_dzr_reports
tools.description: List stored State Audit Office report metadata with date and source link. Use for public audit-report discovery; full third-party report text is not returned.

tools.name: get_source_policy
tools.description: Return the authoritative list of enabled data sources, exposed fields, source attribution, reuse restrictions, and disabled market-data categories. Check this before claiming that MCP provides quotes, indices, currency rates, or full third-party text.
